about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for hse-cis26 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: All the headings (Introduction, Health effects, Skin contact, Dermatitis, Cement burns, Inhalation of dust, Manual handling, Ill health prevention and health surveillance) are read as body text, so the page has no sections.
findings.evidence: tree: "(revision2) Introduction Cement is widely used" / "heavy weights. Ill health prevention and health surveillance Skin contact You should first consider"

findings.problem: The rest of the page, from 'Skin contact' on, is merged into the 'manual handling' bullet.
findings.evidence: tree: "• manual handling. Skin contact Contact with wet cement can cause both dermatitis and burns."

findings.problem: The paragraphs after the third bullet, including the rule that health surveillance never reduces the need to control exposure, are merged into the last bullet.
findings.evidence: tree: "give early warning of lapses in control. Health surveillance must never be regarded as reducing the need to control exposure"

findings.problem: The headings Inhalation of dust, Manual handling and Legal provisions are run into body text instead of being kept as headings.
findings.evidence: tree: "Inhalation of dust Exposure to dust should be eliminated" / "Manual handling Manual handling of heavy loads" / "Legal provisions The Control of Substances"
